summary_en: The study tests vusolimogene oderparepvec (RP1), a genetically modified oncolytic herpes simplex type 1 virus, in primary melanoma to see whether it reduces the risk of sentinel lymph node metastasis. RP1 is injected into the skin at the tumor biopsy site on day 1, day 15 and day 21, and definitive surgery is planned up to 28 to 35 days after the first injection. The main outcome is not stated; the study is labeled early phase 1.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa vusolimogene oderparepvec (RP1), un virus herpes simple tipo 1 modificado genéticamente con actividad oncolítica, en melanoma primario, para ver si reduce el riesgo de metástasis en el ganglio linfático centinela. RP1 se inyecta en la piel en el sitio de la biopsia del tumor el día 1, el día 15 y el día 21, y la cirugía definitiva está prevista hasta 28 a 35 días después de la primera inyección. El resultado principal no está indicado; el estudio está clasificado como fase temprana 1.
who_for: Melanoma staged pT3b, T4a or T4b on biopsy
Grossly visible residual tumor or positive deep or lateral margin on initial biopsy
People of reproductive potential agree to highly effective contraception
not_for: Prior treatment with an oncolytic virus therapy
Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV infection
Investigational agent or device use within four weeks before first dose
Live vaccine within 30 days before first dose
Uveal melanoma, or tumors near critical structures such as the carotid artery or portal vein
